naming_convention.verb_form_description: Use past participle (criado/confirmada/autorizada/recebido). Events describe a fait accompli, not a command.

headers.name: correlationId
headers.description: Request correlation id (from MDC); pairs the event with the producing request and downstream logs.

headers.name: {{ multi_tenancy_term }}Id
headers.description: Tenant id (slug like 'emp_alpha'). May be null for global modules where is_global=true.

headers.name: producedAt
headers.description: Time when the producer emitted the event (server clock, with timezone).

payload_fields.name: eventId
payload_fields.description: Idempotency key — consumers MUST be idempotent on this id.

payload_fields.name: producedAt
payload_fields.description: Same as the header; duplicated in body for archival.

payload_fields.name: producer
payload_fields.description: Identifies the emitting service instance and its version.

payload_fields.name: {{ multi_tenancy_term }}Id
payload_fields.description: Same as header. Null for global events.

payload_fields.name: causationId
payload_fields.description: eventId that triggered this event (when applicable).

payload_fields.name: actor
payload_fields.description: Who caused the event. Optional for system-triggered events.

idempotency.description: Consumers persist eventId in processed_events before any side effect; retries with the same eventId are no-ops.

outbox.description: When the event publication MUST happen if and only if the database commit succeeds, write to outbox_event in the same transaction and have a separate publisher poll-and-send. Avoids ghost events on rollback.

destination_type_rule.description: queue = one consumer (e.g. audit-service only). topic = N independent subscribers each receive their own copy.

$comment: Workspace ships with empty modules (D-103, Gap B). See _examples/eerripe-events.partial.json for the BOSQ-ERP event catalog. Envelope conventions + naming_convention stay framework-level above.
